scenarioRules.tieExplanationDanish: Ved 50 mod 50 har den republikanske vicepræsident J.D. Vance den afgørende stemme. Demokraternes gruppe skal derfor nå 51 for at sikre kontrollen.
scenarioRules.independentWarningDanish: De to nuværende uafhængige senatorer samarbejder med Demokraterne. Nye uafhængige vindere er ikke automatisk placeret i en af de to grupper.
assumptions: Current senators whose seats are not up in 2026 retain their present party/caucus affiliation.
King and Sanders retain their present Democratic caucus affiliation.
New independent or third-party winners stay in a separate unallocated group unless a documented caucus choice is available.
The current Republican vice president remains in office.
Control indicates the modeled organizational balance, not a prediction of individual roll-call votes or passage of bills.
No election outcomes or probability ratings are inferred from current party control.

geometry.recommendation: Convert topology.objects.states with topojson-client, filter the exact 50 state FIPS IDs, then render with d3.geoAlbersUsa and geoPath. Alaska and Hawaii appear as standard inset regions; label them explicitly. Do not manually draw outlines.
